packs.name: Minecraft 5th Birthday Skin Pack
packs.description: Join the celebrations for the 5th birthday of Minecraft with this new, Free Skin pack featuring the one and only 4J Studios development team! Party on!

packs.name: Minecraft 4th Birthday Skin Pack
packs.description: Dress up for the Party with this new, Free Skin pack and celebrate together the 4th Minecraft birthday!

packs.name: Minecraft 3rd Birthday Skin Pack
packs.description: Celebrate Minecraft’s 3rd Birthday on Xbox with the original Minecraft developers! Find their personal skins in this free celebration pack.

packs.name: Minecraft 2nd Birthday Skin Pack
packs.description: Minecraft is growing up, time to celebrate together our 2nd Birthday!

packs.name: Minecraft Birthday Skin Pack
packs.description: Join the Minecraft party now!

packs.name: Minecraft Battle and the Beasts Skin Pack
packs.description: By popular demand, Warriors and Animals are the main flavours for this Skin Pack. Hope you enjoy customizing your Minecraft character with these!

packs.name: Minecraft Battle and the Beasts 2 Skin Pack
packs.description: This second Battle & Beasts pack brings you more Animals, more Warriors and some surprising Mammals too! I am the Walrus!

packs.name: Adventure Time Skin Pack
packs.description: Mash-up! Featured in this pack: your favorite Adventure Time characters, the Land of Ooo, a bespoke texture set, BMO themed UI and original soundtrack.

packs.name: Minecraft Biome Settlers Skin Pack
packs.description: Check out these new looks, influenced by the Forest, Tundra, and Desert biomes. All of these skins have been inspired by the world of Minecraft and the different ways you play!

packs.name: Minecraft Biome Settlers 2 Skin Pack
packs.description: Dress as a denizen of the Nether or a Mushroom Island!

packs.name: Minecraft Campfire Tales Skin Pack
packs.description: Gather round the fire and listen to the tales of these 16 spooky skins! From mythical monsters to horrible hauntings and other strange sightings, this supernatural skin pack is the ideal way to frighten friends this Halloween.

packs.name: Minecraft Chinese Mythology Skin Pack
packs.description: Journey through epic terrain and find enlightenment in the land of dragons with this Mash-up Pack inspired by the myths and legends of China. Minecrafters get to explore a Chinese Mythology-themed world, with glorious Textures, legendary Skins and enchanting Music. The Pack also includes a themed Battle map exclusive to this Mash-up!

packs.name: Minecraft Classic Skin Pack 1
packs.description: Never doubt a classic!

packs.name: Doctor Who Volume I Skin Pack
packs.description: Launch yourself on an epic adventure in space and time with the Minecraft Doctor Who Skins Volume I. Over 50 characters from all eras of the show including the First, Fourth,  Eleventh and Twelfth Doctors, Amy Pond, Clara Oswald, Rose Tyler, Zygons, The Master, Weeping Angels, the Daleks and their evil creator Davros.

packs.name: Doctor Who Volume II Skin Pack
packs.description: Zooming through the Time Vortex, hot on the heels of the first Minecraft Doctor Who Skin pack, comes Volume II. Over 50 characters from all eras of the show including the Second, Third, Eighth and Tenth Doctors, Donna Noble, Captain Jack Harkness, K9, Brigadier Lethbridge-Stewart, the Sea Devil and the Cybermen in all their guises from the 60's through to the most recent and deadly upgrade.

packs.name: Minecraft Egyptian Mythology Skin Pack
packs.description: Will you survive the perils of the Pyramids? Journey through the Valley of the Kings, dodge deadly traps and explore the ancient tombs below! The fourth pack in the Mythology series, this Egyptian-themed Mash-up comes with textures fit for a Pharaoh, legendary mobs, a pantheon of skins and an epic soundtrack!

packs.name: Minecraft Noctis Skin Pack
packs.description: Join Noctis, Gladio, Ignis and Prompto once again as they venture beyond the world of Eos and into the untold realms of Minecraft with this fantastic skin pack. Be it friend or foe, the cast of FINAL FANTASY XV follows, including Cindy, Aranea, Ardyn, the Astrals and many more.

packs.name: Fallout Skin Pack
packs.description: Welcome to the wasteland! Crack open the Vault containing 44 unique skins from the Fallout Mash-Up Pack.

packs.name: Minecraft Festive Mash-Up Skin Pack
packs.description: Celebrate the Festive period with this wintery Mash-up Pack containing a Festive style Texture Pack, Skin Pack, new music and a Festive world!

packs.name: Minecraft Festive Skin Pack
packs.description: Here's a fab mini pack of 24 skins to customize your Minecraft character with, and get you in the mood for the holidays.

packs.name: From the Shadows Skin Pack
packs.description: Get these excruciatingly detailed horrors in the "From the Shadows" HD skin pack.

packs.name: Minecraft Greek Mythology Skin Pack
packs.description: It’s mythical Greece at your thumb sticks in this new Minecraft Mash-up pack! Greek gods, fantastical creatures and epic locations are all sculpted into our dedicated game world. We've even made a bespoke texture set and themed UI, and wrapped it all up with an orchestral soundtrack. This is the stuff of legends! Go make your own!

packs.name: Minecraft MINECON Earth 2017 Skin Pack
packs.description: Join the party, wherever you are - and get dressed for the occasion with these fancy skins, celebrating everything from cosplay to cake! Available for a short time only, so get 'em fast!

packs.name: Minecraft Halloween Charity Skin Pack
packs.description: Skins from Minecraft: Xbox 360 Edition developer 4J Studios are joined by creations from 343 Industries, Rare, Mojang, Ronimo, Twisted Pixel, Tequila Works and more.

packs.name: Minecraft Halloween 2015 Skin Pack
packs.description: Happy Halloween! Dress suitably spookily and prepare for the ultimate Minecraft Halloween thrill ride!

packs.name: Halo Skin Pack
packs.description: Includes 56 Halo character skins from Legacy Console Edition.

packs.name: LittleBigPlanet™ Skin Pack
packs.description:
Mix the crazy, non-stop creativity of LittleBigPlanet™ into the endless fun and freedom of Minecraft with this special mashup pack.

Sackboy®, Sackgirl®, OddSock, Toggle and Swoop will decorate your Minecraft universe with a whole heap of LBP™ characters, creatures and stuff.

packs.name: Magic The Gathering Skin Pack
packs.description: Deck yourself out as the most powerful Planeswalkers in the Multiverse.

packs.name: Mass Effect Skin Pack
packs.description: Shape the fate of your Minecraft galaxy with this amazing Mash-up: includes thirty-six character skins, bespoke game textures, themed menus, a dedicated world filled with iconic locations and original soundtrack compilation to set the mood.

packs.name: Minecraft MINECON 2015 Skin Pack
packs.description: MINECON 2015 Skin Pack is a celebratory skin pack for MINECON 2015 that includes 8 skins of Steve and Alex wearing MINECON capes.

packs.name: Minecraft MINECON 2016 Skin Pack
packs.description: MINECON 2016 Skin Pack is a celebratory skin pack for MINECON 2016 that includes 14 skins.

packs.name: Minecraft Mini Game Heroes Skin Pack
packs.description: Become a Mini Game legend with this new sporting skin pack! Swoop round Glide's tightest tracks in lithe llama-suit, cushion Tumble-based fumbles with fluffy cat pads or don your Guardian get-up to bolster both your Battle ranking and your fashion game.

packs.name: Minecraft Mini Game Masters Skin Pack
packs.description: Calling all beasts of Battle, titans of Tumble and gods of Glide: the ultimate in Mini Game themed sporting skins are here! So slip into that streamlined spandex, strap on those sturdy pads, and prepare to out-style AND out-play your friends.

packs.name: Marvel's Avengers Skin Pack
packs.description: Marvel Avengers Skin Pack is a skin pack containing 35 skins of characters from the Avengers superhero comic book series.

packs.name: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy Skin Pack
packs.description: Marvel Guardians of the Galaxy Skin Pack is a skin pack containing 24 skins of characters from the superhero film Guardians of the Galaxy by Marvel Studios, as well as the comic series of the same name.

packs.name: Marvel's Spider-Man Skin Pack
packs.description: Marvel Spider-Man Skin Pack is a skin pack containing 35 skins of characters from the Spider-Man superhero franchise by Marvel Entertainment.

packs.name: Moana Skin Pack
packs.description: Set sail with Moana, Maui and all the crew from Motunui. How far will you go in Minecraft with this adventurous character set? You’re welcome!

packs.name: Minecraft Norse Mythology Skin Pack
packs.description: Are you heroic enough to enter the Great Hall, Valhalla? Find out in the Norse Mythology Mash-up! Compose your own grand saga as you voyage through the nine realms, from the treetops of Yggdrasil, down into the mines of Svartalfheim and the depths of Hel! The third episode in the mythology series, this pack has hand-carved textures, a thunderous soundtrack and a horde of skins. Skål!

packs.name: Power Rangers Skin Pack
packs.description: Including the 5 original Power Rangers and many more characters from the classic series, this skin pack is nothing short of Morphinominal.

packs.name: Pirates of the Caribbean Skin Pack
packs.description: Explore the shipwrecks of Minecraft's oceans with than Captain Jack Sparrow, Blackbeard, Davy Jones and over forty (count 'em!) skins from all five movies.

packs.name: Minecraft Redstone Specialists Skin Pack
packs.description: Dress as the Scholar, Protector, and more!

packs.name: Minecraft Summer of Arcade Skin Pack
packs.description: The Summer of Arcade Skin Pack was a free skin pack, featuring 15 skins of characters from video games that were part of the 2012 Summer of Arcade event on the Xbox Live Arcade.

packs.name: Minecraft Skin Pack 1
packs.description: Customise your character with this selection of stunning skins!

packs.name: Minecraft Skin Pack 2
packs.description: Customise your Minecraft character with this 2nd selection of stunning skins!

packs.name: Minecraft Skin Pack 3
packs.description: Here's the third superb pack of skins for you to customise your Minecraft character with! We hope you will enjoy it!

packs.name: Minecraft Skin Pack 4
packs.description: Here's the fourth superb pack of skins for you to customise your Minecraft character with! We hope you will enjoy it!

packs.name: Minecraft Skin Pack 5
packs.description: Here's the fith superb pack of skins for you to customise your Minecraft character with! We hope you will enjoy it!

packs.name: Minecraft Skin Pack 6
packs.description: Here's the sixth superb pack of skins for you to customise your Minecraft character with! We hope you will enjoy it!

packs.name: Super Mario Skin Pack
packs.description: The Super Mario Mash-Up Pack is a free mash-up pack exclusively available for the Nintendo console versions of Minecraft.

packs.name: Solo: A Star Wars Story Skin Pack
packs.description: Buckle up and jump into hyperspace with the Solo: A Star Wars Story™ Skin Pack! Assemble a crew with characters like Han Solo, Lando Calrissian, L3-37 and more!

packs.name: Star Wars Classic Skin Pack
packs.description: A long time ago in a galaxy far, far away....  The Star Wars Classic Skin Pack features an assortment of over 50 heroes, villains, and rogues from the Galactic Civil War.  Whether you pick a Jawa or the mighty Darth Vader, you can play as your favorite Star Wars characters from Episodes IV to VI, Minecraft style.

packs.name: Star Wars Prequel Skin Pack
packs.description: A long time ago in a galaxy far, far away....  The Star Wars Prequel Skin Pack is now available.  Choose from over 50 skins and play as some of your favorite Star Wars characters, Minecraft style.

packs.name: Star Wars Rebels Skin Pack
packs.description: Are you ready to join the rebellion - Minecraft style? The Star Wars Rebels Skin Pack features the crew of the Ghost and their adversaries in the Galactic Empire. Choose from over 20 skins and play as your favourite Star Wars Rebels characters.

packs.name: Star Wars Sequel Skin Pack
packs.description: Star Wars Sequel Skin Pack, featuring a total of 53 characters from The Force Awakens and The Last Jedi.

packs.name: Steven Universe Skin Pack
packs.description: This mash-up contains your favourite locations, from Beach City all the way to Homeworld, original music from the show, and a diamond-shattering 48 skins!

packs.name: Minecraft Story Mode Skin Pack
packs.description: Create your own adventure with this skin pack featuring your favorite characters from Minecraft: Story Mode. All the Jesse, Olivia, Axel, Petra skins and many more are included!

packs.name: Stranger Things Skin Pack
packs.description: Something is coming, something hungry for blood. A shadow grows on the wall behind you, swallowing you in darkness. It is almost here… Boom! Stranger Things comes to Minecraft! Join Mike, Dustin, Lucas, Will, Eleven, Joyce, Hopper and many more as they survive monsters, adolescence and 80's fashion choices.

packs.name: Minecraft Strangers - Biome Settlers 3 Skin Pack
packs.description: Get this pack and make your home in distant lands or ocean depths!

packs.name: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Skin Pack
packs.description: The Dragonborn meets Minecraft in a clash of epic proportions. Build your own worlds in the land of Tamriel and experience adventure with many of its most iconic characters. Fus Ro Dah!

packs.name: The Nightmare Before Christmas Skin Pack
packs.description: This is one of our best festive mash-ups yet! Jack Skellington and his fearsome friends are all here, making for a wonderfully ghoulish gallery of 40 spooktacular skins. As well as those 40 skins, you get a texture pack and a world full of some truly nightmarish redstone puzzles to solve, all scored to the excellent soundtrack from the movie!

packs.name: Toy Story Skin Pack
packs.description: Play as Woody, Buzz Lightyear, Jessie, Bo Peep, Forky and more Toy Story characters.

packs.name: Minecraft Super Cute Skin Pack
packs.description: The Super Cute Skin Pack lets you create a cheerful world full of the cutest and cuddliest mobs! Bouncing bunnies, ultra-adorable unicorns, brilliant bumblebees and, er, burgers? Yes, burgers! Even the squid will make you Squeee! This skin pack comes with 15 skins!

packs.name: The Incredibles Skin Pack
packs.description: Grab your super suit and join the action with the Parr family and other heroes and villains in this incredible skin pack!

packs.name: The Simpsons Skin Pack
packs.description: Create your own blocky version of Springfield with the entire Simpsons family - Homer, Marge, Bart, Lisa and Maggie - plus 19 of Springfield Elementary School’s beloved characters from the Emmy Award-winning animated show and the longest-running scripted show in television history.

packs.name: Minecraft Villains Skin Pack
packs.description: Unleash your inner villain with a pack dripping in the devious, the dastardly and the downright despicable! Scoundrels and schemers, mischief-makers and malevolent masterminds - this pack has the lot. Can you tell fiend from foe?
